# Material Design navigation icons

`arrow_back`, `arrow_downward`, `arrow_upward`, `arrow_forward`, `extension`, `person`, `music_note`, `auto_awesome`, 24 px Material Icons,
Copyright Google LLC. Downloaded from the [google/material-design-icons repository](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/tree/10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7/src/navigation), commit `10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7`, under the Apache License 2.0 in `LICENSE`.

The original SVGs are retained here; their nonempty path data was converted to Android vector drawables in `app/src/main/res/drawable/chart_arrow_*.xml` and `tool_*.xml` and rendered with custom tints. These are UI icons, not the official FNF note sprites.
